name: 炉脊总监
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original boss combat body for the 2D action RPG Abyss Salvager, abandoned-mine industrial fantasy. Premium hand-painted stylized game rendering, sculptural soft top-left light, charcoal iron, worn copper, ivory mineral edges, restrained emissive cores, broad readable forms and deliberately controlled texture. Match a coherent family of salvaged mining machinery and mineral-organic creatures, but create an entirely original boss. Camera: elevated three-quarter top-down view, looking down about 40 degrees, facing lower-right. Single full body in a grounded ready-to-fight pose. Entire body, tools and limbs visible with 10 percent clear transparent margin. Square canvas. Designed to be legible when displayed 140–180 pixels high: strong unique silhouette, few broad contrasting masses, iconic organs visible, no tiny tangled decoration. Truly transparent PNG alpha cutout, virtually opaque character interiors, narrow antialiased edges only. No background, black backdrop, gradient, floor, base, pedestal, ground shadow, scene props, text, glyphs, numbers, watermark, UI, borders, extra creatures, floating attack effects, baked warning rings or diagrams. No franchise resemblance. Subject BO01 Furnace-Spine Overseer / 炉脊总监: a massive squat WIDE-SHOULDERED walking mining foundry, deliberately blocky trapezoid silhouette on two short hydraulic legs. EXACTLY THREE small blast-furnace towers rise from its upper back, their three chimneys and hot copper-orange vent mouths clearly separated against transparency. One complete articulated arm carries one gigantic broad square forging hammer, held outward in a readable ready-to-lift posture; the opposite complete arm is a deep curved slag LADLE with a heavy lip and a modest contained orange glow. The hammer and ladle must have obviously different large silhouettes. Thick iron jaw-like chest, small guarded amber inspection lens instead of human face, soot black segmented plates and oxidized russet/copper edges. Back vents and exposed hydraulic struts visually communicate a rear heat-release weak point. Chunky heavy feet and knees, weight forward, whole body coherent machinery, NOT a man in armor. Three large furnaces, exactly two arms, exactly two legs. Dramatic but controlled warm internal furnace glow, no flames or smoke outside silhouette. Finely made worn material detail without making the dark body unreadable.
postprocessing: None; source PNG and alpha copied unchanged.
limitations: Static body artwork only; does not constitute animation or boss gameplay acceptance.

visual_inspection: Three separate furnace towers, square hammer, deep slag ladle and two complete hydraulic legs are visible.
Large warm furnace shapes separate from broad charcoal steel mass; no ground, text or UI.
qa.alpha_method: System.Drawing read-only GetPixel stride4; visible alpha>16, near-opaque alpha>=240; actual outermost edges checked at every pixel. No image pixels edited.
qa.runtime_scale_validation: Shape design and source checked; actual engine-scale rendering is owned by boss runtime integration and is not claimed here.
qa.limitations: A single static body, not direction variants, phase poses, attack animation, or complete boss gameplay.
